buy_idea_pitch: No hardware exists yet: this page is the idea, published so the design can happen in public. Open an issue, sketch a schematic, or leave your email and watch it become real.
concept_body: This one is still being designed and everything about it can change: shape, spec, price, timing. That is why there is no product page yet. Once hardware is in testing the full page appears here.
buy_stock_bundle_in: Both boards in stock · ships from Belgium
what_is_this_link_home: See how the whole drone works →
ch_open_source_title: Published so you can study it. Produced so you don't have to.
ch_teardown_title_frame: Every arm, plate and standoff, exploded
ch_in_the_box_title_bundle: Two boards, two firmwares, *two maintainers paid.*
ch_downloads_title: Files you can fork, *build on, or audit.*
teardown_tour_hint: Tap one to find it on the board
in_the_box_bundle_body: The bundle is just OpenFC-Lite and OpenESC shipped together. No combined SKU, no tied hardware: each board is the same one you can buy on its own. What you save is courier-and-handling.
downloads_intro: Straight from the repo. If a link 404s, the file moved; open an issue on the matching GitHub repo and we'll point it back.
firmware_support_body: {project} is community firmware we didn't write, and it is what makes this board fly.
contributor_you_cta: talk to us on Discord first
reviews_intro: Collected by email after delivery, published unedited. “Verified buyer” means the reviewer's order is on file. The average here is the same number search engines get: {average} over {count} {ratings}.
gpsr_warnings_en: Not a toy. Not for persons under 14; minors only under adult supervision.
Component for self-built unmanned aircraft: the builder is responsible for the assembled aircraft and its lawful operation.
LiPo batteries can ignite when damaged, shorted or overcharged; never charge unattended.
Remove propellers before bench testing, configuration or firmware updates.
Observe the voltage and current limits in the specifications; reverse polarity destroys the board.
gpsr_warnings_nl: Geen speelgoed. Niet voor personen onder 14 jaar; minderjarigen alleen onder toezicht van een volwassene.
Component voor zelfgebouwde onbemande luchtvaartuigen: de bouwer is verantwoordelijk voor het samengestelde toestel en het wettige gebruik ervan.
LiPo-batterijen kunnen ontbranden bij beschadiging, kortsluiting of overladen; laad nooit zonder toezicht.
Verwijder propellers vóór benchtests, configuratie of firmware-updates.
Respecteer de spannings- en stroomlimieten in de specificaties; omgekeerde polariteit vernietigt het board.
gpsr_warnings_fr: Ceci n'est pas un jouet. Interdit aux moins de 14 ans ; mineurs uniquement sous surveillance d'un adulte.
Composant pour aéronefs sans équipage auto-construits : le constructeur est responsable de l'appareil assemblé et de son utilisation licite.
Les batteries LiPo peuvent s’enflammer en cas de dommage, de court-circuit ou de surcharge ; ne chargez jamais sans surveillance.
Retirez les hélices avant les essais au banc, la configuration ou les mises à jour du firmware.
Respectez les limites de tension et de courant des spécifications ; une inversion de polarité détruit la carte.
